The '''Flowerveil Puppet''' {{Lang|zh=花幔傀儡}}, also known as the '''Grand Helm''', is an NPC who is first mentioned during [[Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled]]. She is the current Grand Helm of [[Zhuojun Atelier]]. 

A mysterious craftswoman who maintains an elusive, enigmatic profile amidst [[Mengzhou]]'s society, she is understood to be a figure with dubious motives and machinations in the region. She actively oversees the work of the Zhuojun Atelier's craftspeople. Despite her inscrutable nature, she maintains order and law across her organization.

==Profile==
Little is known about her beyond how she is described by individuals such as [[Suisui]] and [[Muyu]]. Suisui describes her as "elusive, with questionable morals", and Muyu dismissively regarded her as a narrow-minded woman who is incapable of having ambitions beyond those she has laid out for Mengzhou, implying that she may be a highly ambitious, covert figure with designs solely focused on manipulating the local affairs of the region from behind the scenes.<ref>{{Quest|Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled}}</ref>

==Story==
===History===
Over 20 years ago, she had chosen Muyu to succeed her as the next Grand Helm. However, Muyu rejected the offer and publicly left the organization, leading to her retaining her seat in the organization up to modern times.<ref>{{Quest|Song of the Heart Sword}} Dialogue:
:'''Suisui:''' About twenty years back, [[Muyu|he]] was supposed to succeed the Flowerveil Puppet as the next Grand Helm. Instead, he announced his departure from the [[Zhuojun Atelier|organization]] and vanished.

:'''Yangyang:''' After that... he probably hid in [[Xuanfang]] under another identity. Biding his time. Refining his plan.</ref>

After [[Suoming]] and [[Yinlin]] intercepted two members of Muyu's racketeering network who still worked for [[Zhuojun Atelier]], they were captured by the duo and directly taken to the Flowerveil Puppet in Mengzhou, as a means of making them face consequences in the organization for their role in Muyu's regional terrorism.<ref>{{Quest|The Nethermancer's Requiem}}</ref> 

According to Suisui, the Flowerveil Puppet allegedly cut ties with Muyu. While being investigated by Suisui, she disavowed Muyu's [[Balanophora|ties]] to the [[Fractsidus]], downplaying it as purportedly only being a relationship built on sharing technology, which had ended years ago. However, this was doubted by Suisui, who believed the Flowerveil Puppet to possibly be covering the Atelier's complicity.<ref>{{Quest|Song of the Heart Sword}} Dialogue:
:'''Suisui:''' We've only got one lead, from the Grand Helm herself. She said [[Muyu]] traded technology with the [[Fractsidus]] years ago, but the relationship didn't last.

:'''Suisui:''' Hard to say if that's true or just the Atelier trying to cover its tracks.</ref>

==Trivia==
*Suisui's suspicion that the Flowerveil Puppet is lying to conceal the truth of Muyu's alliance with [[Balanophora]] is one that can be backed up by hidden logs found across both [[Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled]] and [[Song of the Heart Sword]]. Whether this is a sign of a simple cover-up, something she was unaware of, or an indication of a deeper malicious compliance between Zhuojun Atelier and the Fractsidus currently remains unknown.
**During the former, if one examines Muyu's Censure Court site at the Skyworks during Rover's portion of the questline, a note can be found that extensively details his intent to work with [[Balanophora]], referred to by him in writing as the "woman in red," after frustrations with the [[Ministry of Development]]'s incompetence, along with his contempt for having to debase himself to conspiring with the Fractsidus.<ref>{{Quest|Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled}} A Few Scribbled Notes:
:'''Muyu:''' The new Artisans from the [[Ministry of Development]] are completely useless. They don't even have basic skills. I have no idea how they passed the exams. At least their attitude is decent. They still respect knowledge. Not a total lost cause. I'll compile a handbook for them. Save them wasting my time with questions... … The [[Fractsidus]]... a bunch of lawless fanatics. They've approached me so many times. Do they really think I'd become their lapdog? Ridiculous. Still... their network could be useful for my research. The timing is perfect now. Not a single step can afford to go wrong. The next time I see that [[Balanophora|woman in red]], I won't turn her away immediately. No harm in hearing what she has to say...
</ref> 
**During the latter, communication logs can be found aboard the Cloud Shuttle fleet that depict Muyu and Balanophora discussing their agreement to seize the Mengzhou civilization capsule.<ref>{{Quest|Song of the Heart Sword}} A Damaged Communication Log:
:'''[[Balanophora|Gentle Female Voice:]]''' As you requested, ████ has fallen into isolation.

:'''Gentle Female Voice:''' Nothing stands between you and your plans now, but don't forget our agreement.

:'''[[Muyu|Stern Male Voice:]]''' Sure, ████ is yours.

:'''Stern Male Voice:''' But only after I've obtained the ██ inside of it.

:'''Gentle Female Voice:''' Very well, I'll be waiting.

:'''Gentle Female Voice:''' So it seems... you are no different from the [[Court of Savantae]] after all.
</ref>
**Muyu himself also admits during his defeat at the end of Song of the Heart Sword that he and Balanophora were working together under the shared goal of sabotaging Hsin's Civilization Capsule, despite Muyu's personal indifference towards her.<ref>{{Quest|Song of the Heart Sword}} Dialogue:
:'''Muyu:''' Do not misunderstand. The [[Hsin|Sentinel]]'s knowledge is my only concern. The one who wanted this Capsule? Ask your old enemy.

:'''(Rover):''' ...The [[Ovathrax|Threnodian]]?

:'''(Rover):''' ...The [[Fractsidus]]?

:'''Muyu:''' [[Xuanfang]] is but one corner of the chaos in [[Mengzhou]]. Unfortunately, I have no interest in [[Balanophora]]'s petty schemes.</ref>
